description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ForbiddenException' for the OrangeHRM authentication module. The class extends PHP's Exception and implements Symfony's HttpExceptionInterface, providing methods to manage HTTP status code and headers related to forbidden access errors.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing a HTTP 403 Forbidden error, including methods to get and set status code and headers.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for this exception.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with this exception.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for this exception.
